NGA.note: The guidance notes concern the NCC Internet Code of Practice 2026 (traffic, child safety, platforms, AI); they state nothing on electronic transactions or e-commerce law.

facts.fact: Nigeria's NCC says its Internet Code of Practice 2026, re-issued as Guidelines under section 70 of the Nigerian Communications Act and binding on licensees as subsidiary legislation, requires licensees to notify the Commission before deploying any AI tool or algorithm, with a 15-day review.
Nigeria's NCC states in the Code's guidance notes that the Commission has governance management over the deployment of AI and emerging technologies on the networks.

NGA.note: No government body's use of an AI system stated.
No AI tool in a sector system stated.
No AI model, dataset or computing built in the country stated.
Only says NCC will work with the NDPC on personal data; no law, standing or decision on a general data protection law stated.
